exclusions: Every lead and candidate from all earlier immutable requests was excluded before ranking, including New Place, Root Signal, Schiebung, Germanium, the R 417 remixes, NX1, Voyage and Echoes From The Abyss.
All current ledger tracks, durable rejected entries, frozen Session 4 material and untriggered PARKED revisit entries were excluded.
SHAWN's Spirit EP was excluded because it remains a preorder on the scan date and only one track is available; unreleased versions were not submitted for Spotify resolution.

Aeikus — Isolated and D. Diggler — Boulder Dash were excluded because their verified 132 and 124 BPM values leave no concrete non-protected placement in the current 134–145 BPM body and protected final descent.

Orion — The Veil of Bells was excluded because its track-specific closer framing conflicts with the protected ending; industrial, hard, relentless, acid-rave and impact-led material was excluded for spectacle or pressure risk.
Hush Me Luck tracks supported only by compilation-level minimal or groove language were excluded when no concrete track-specific role could be stated honestly.
No proposed placement enters Iruka → Percussion Work → Interlynx, splits Deep Under → Wurk, or touches Interlynx → Minimum → Eclipse → Haidou → Calipso.
